## Summary

Describe what changes and why. Link the design decision or issue when there is one.

## Type of change

Pick the Conventional Commit type that matches the PR title.

- [ ] feat: new behavior
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] style: formatting, no logic change
- [ ] refactor: restructuring, no behavior change
- [ ] perf: performance improvement
- [ ] test: tests only
- [ ] build: build system or dependencies
- [ ] ci: pipeline changes
- [ ] chore: maintenance
- [ ] revert: reverts an earlier change

## Jira item

Issue key from the LatiFi Jira project, for example the project key followed by a number.

## Checklist

- [ ] The `ci` check is green
- [ ] The `commit-lint` check is green
- [ ] No secrets, private keys or RPC keys are committed
- [ ] No AI co-author trailers or generated-with lines in commits or in this description
- [ ] Docs are updated when behavior changes
